name: cc-clawd
description: Pixel pets for Claude Code: Clawd and any pet you define, living in the band above the prompt

plugins.name: clawd
plugins.description: A 60 Hz pixel pet above the prompt that reacts to Claude and to any mod or program that signals it; hosts other mods' band rows; real pixels on kitty/Ghostty, interactive on the desktop app

plugins.name: focus-timer
plugins.description: Example guest of cc-clawd: /focus 25 starts a focus block; the pet types and counts down in the band, then celebrates (falls back to the status line without the pet)
